result.scope: Predicts every text byte, allocated-data pointer, symbol value and entrypoint under the independent qualified-section permutation. REL record ordering is treated as a verified multiset permutation; no ELF input or output is edited. This is baseline-to-reordered-candidate preservation, not identity with the deployed original.
